verdict.rationale: Khoj's docs show API-key setup for OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini (khoj-docs-46), local models via Ollama (khoj-docs-9), and any API-backed LLM through LiteLLM (khoj-docs-10). The README claims chat with any local or online LLM (khoj-gh-2), and agents can each be assigned their own chat model (khoj-gh-1). Admins can add multiple chat models to switch between (khoj-docs-50). Older community reports that chat required OpenAI reflect an earlier state and do not concretely contradict the current multi-provider docs. Missing for 10: explicit OpenRouter support (only implied via LiteLLM/OpenAI-compatible routes), clear documentation of per-conversation model switching, and independent hands-on corroboration of multi-provider use.
